title: WaterColor 188 Spartina Circle
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Per WaterColor HOA, all guests 5 years of age or older must be included in your adult guest total in order to receive wristbands to access amenities and pools. This home is allotted 10 wristbands.- Located in WaterColor's Camp District- Recently redecorated - Casually elegant decor - 6 passenger Low-Speed Vehicle - 2nd living area/den/office- Separate seating for playing cards, puzzles & internet - 4 adult bikes- 2 dedicated parking spots with additional parking found throughout the community- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutGuests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and third pool with zero-entry, as well an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico.DETAILS: 188 Spartina Circle is a beautiful home in the Camp District of Watercolor. This home features two large porches in the front and back of the home. On the front porch, there are 4 lounge chairs and a round table on one side, and an outdoor couch and coffee table on the other. The back porch is screened in with a couch and two sets of club chairs which provide ample space to enjoy a cocktail and enjoy the beautiful Florida weather! Upon entering the home, you will notice the open floor plan with beautiful white club chairs and a couch, a wooden desk with a chair on each side, and a wooden dining table with 6 chairs. The other half of this spacious first-floor design is occupied by the beautiful kitchen featuring a large island, bar seats for 3, and all of the prerequisite modern appliances needed for a delicious home-cooked meal. The distinguished primary bedroom has coastal accents, a king bed, TV, and a connecting bathroom with double vanity, large tub and walk-in shower. The second bedroom has a king bed, flat-screen TV, and connecting bath with double vanity, tub, and walk-in shower. The third bedroom has a king bed, a TV, and connecting bathroom with a double vanity and walk-in shower. This home's fourth and final bedroom can be found upstairs on the second floor and has 2 twin-over-queen bunk beds, 3 club chairs, a flat-screen TV, and a small white table with 2 chairs. There is also a connecting bathroom with double vanity, tub and walk-in shower. An added bonus of this spectacular home is the addition of a queen bed in the upstairs hallway.SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (SLEEPS 10):FIRST FLOOR: - Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub - Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Walk-in Shower - Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub SECOND FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: Two Twin-over-Queen Bunk Beds, Shared Bathroom with Shower and Tub- Private Nook: Queen Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower and Tub,
